chat.author: Raghav Kejriwal
chat.text: @Stuart Cheshire - The emulated test path we used was using a drop tail FIFO buffer, however, a study presented at SIGCOMM this year detailed Starlink's use of flow-queuing (https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/3789240.3829162). We aren't sure about what BRDY uses and treat it as a black box service.
